Overview

Visitors to The Westin Kierland Resort Spa will experience almost perfection on every level from the facilities to the staff. Being a AAA Four Diamond Resort guarantees world-class accommodations that also include a full-service spa, world-class golf, upscale shopping, and award-winning dining. Guests can experience a relaxing oasis of opportunity and surroundings.

Each guest room features the Westin’s world-renowned Heavenly Bed and White Tea by Westin amenities. The majority of rooms are offered as suites that include a kitchen and living area. Every room has a private balcony or terrace and some even offer views of the green golf course and vast mountain range. Non-smoking rooms are the standard at the Westin.

The Westin Kierland Resort Spa offers unique dining experiences from their talented chefs. Mouthwatering menus and excellent dining experiences are available in ten unique dining options around the resort. From a quick drink and bite to eat at Brittlebrush Bar and Grill to a contemporary Latin cuisine at deseso, guests will thoroughly enjoy the dining experience.

A stay at The Westin wouldn’t be complete without a visit to either the Agave Spa to relax or a round of golf at one of three 18-hole combinations that The Westin Kierland Golf Course provides. Play a round in the morning and enjoy an afternoon at the spa before showering and experiencing deseo’s fine dining. Outdoor heated pools, running trails and golf or tennis lessons are also available on site.

Each evening guests will experience the resort tribute to Scottish immigrants with its “Scottish Pipes at Sunset” series.

FAQs when booking at The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa

 * What spa services does The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa offer?
   
   Agave, The Arizona Spa at The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa offers a wide range of exclusive and traditional treatments developed by professional therapists. The spa has 27 different treatment rooms for different kinds of treatments and locker rooms and juice bar and movement studio a full-service salon and a cardiovascular studio. The spa offers facials and body massages that aim to rejuvenate the mind spirit and body.

 * How do I get to The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa from the Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)?
   
   If you have just flown into Phoenix through Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport getting to The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa is a breeze because they are not far apart. Travelers at PHX can either use taxis, rideshare services, town cars, bus shuttles, car rentals, or by driving their personal cars. Car rental companies like Alamo, Avis, Hertz, SIXT, Payless, and Dollar charge around $27 per day. Among these, the cheapest option is to drive your own personal car which will cost you around $4 and we'll get you there in around 27min. However, the fastest option is taking a taxi from the airport outside Terminals 3 and 4, which will cost you around $45 and will get you there in 27min.

 * If I bring my pet, what services does The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa provide?
   
   The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa is a pet-friendly hotel and ensures your stay and that of your pet is convenient. The pet allows two pets, both cats and dogs, up to up to 40 lbs. The hotel provides treats, feeding bowls, and beds to guests with pets, upon request. In addition. the pets can relieve themselves in the grassy areas around the hotel.

 * Can I hold an event at The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa?
   
   Yes. For guests who want to hold events like birthdays, graduation, anniversaries, engagement, or even meetings and seminars, The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa is the right place to be. The hotel has indoor and outdoor meeting spaces of over 200,000 sq ft and 41 event rooms. Among them is the Kierland Ballroom which can accommodate over 3600 in one sitting. The equipment and services provided include a portable stage, event lighting, decor, photography services, security guards, and registration services. To coordinate this event, the event planning team at the hotel is at your disposal. They will help you create a custom menu for your guests and have the catering team prepare some delectable dishes. They will even set up decor suitable to the particular party.

 *  What are the business options The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa offers?
   
   The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa has a business center staffed to ensure maximum convenience for guests. At the business center, you can access computers, copying services, and faxing services. In case you’re holding an event and need any help printing out important documents, the business center will take care of exactly that.

 * Where is The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa located?
   
   The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa is located at 6902 East Greenway Parkway in Paradise Valley, 14.3 km from the centre of Scottsdale. Tournament Players Club TPC of Scottsdale - Champion Course is the closest landmark to The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa.

   Yes, The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa offers free Wi-Fi.

   The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa is 2.1 km from Phoenix Scottsdale Municipal. The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa is 21.7 km from Phoenix Sky Harbor Intl.

 * Does The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa have a pool?
   
   Yes, The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa has a pool on-site.

webpage.text:
The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa

Set on 250 acres in North Scottsdale, The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa provides contemporary amenities and design paired with an ever-changing collection of distinctive experiences that brings to life the “Essence of Arizona.”

A revitalizing desert oasis, the property features a collection of multiple dining venues serving an eclectic mix of the area’s finest flavors; Agave, The Arizona Spa & Salon, a full-service rejuvenating destination showcasing rare, desert-inspired treatments and traditional therapies; and The Westin Kierland Golf Club, recognized by Golf Digest as one of America’s 9 Most Cheerful Golf Courses, features 27 holes against the back drop of The McDowell Mountains and is complimented by an AGM Top 100 award winning Golf Shop.

Complementing the resort’s premier amenities, The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa offers a bevy of rotating Arizona excursions and on-property activities, including the property’s Adventure Water Park that is home to a 110-foot-long waterslide, 900-foot lazy river and the Kierland FlowRider board-sport simulator.

A leading destination for meetings and events located steps from premier shopping and dining, the resort boasts more than 200,000 square feet of well-appointed indoor and outdoor space and features the renowned portfolio of signature Westin wellness offerings.

resultats_lens.texte_contexte: The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa est un hôtel situé sur un domaine de 250 acres dans le nord de Scottsdale, en Arizona. L'établissement comprend plusieurs restaurants, le spa Agave The Arizona Spa & Salon, et le club de golf The Westin Kierland Golf Club doté de 27 trous face aux montagnes McDowell. Il dispose également d'un parc aquatique avec une glissade d'eau de 110 pieds, une rivière paresseuse de 900 pieds, et le simulateur Kierland FlowRider. L'hôtel propose plus de 200 000 pieds carrés d'espaces intérieurs et extérieurs pour des réunions et des événements.

About the neighborhood

Located in Paradise Valley Village, a neighborhood in Scottsdale, The Westin Kierland Resort and Spa is in a shopping district. Kierland Commons and Desert Ridge Marketplace are worth checking out if shopping is on the agenda, while those wishing to experience the area's natural beauty can explore Camelback Mountain. Traveling with kids? Make time for Phoenix Zoo, or check out an event or a game at Westworld of Scottsdale. Enjoy the great outdoors with hiking/biking trails, horse riding, and mountain biking, or hop on a moped rental nearby and explore all the area has to offer. Visit our Scottsdale travel guide
